summary:
Iter 48 — final pre-competition smoke & regression. rca_of_issue: Translation sweep RCA — the ~300 exact-string replacements landed against some files (e.g. /inner-circle, home) but the majority of the target screens (/token, /recovery-suite, /pantry, /compass, /monolith, /protocol, /eternal-vault, /wealth-vault, ...) still ship literal Slovak strings. Most likely causes: (a) the replacement dictionary was keyed on a limited subset of exact source strings and the actual strings in those files don't match verbatim (extra whitespace, punctuation, gerund/imperative variants, or embedded template literals), or (b) the sweep script matched by testID/component name rather than by literal string. Fix approach for E1: for each remaining screen, open the file, grep for the Slovak diacritic set, and replace each literal string one-by-one — the strings are hard-coded (not i18n keys), so a targeted per-file edit is required. simulate-beam 502 RCA — /app/backend/core.py storage subsystem calls integrations.emergentagent.com/objstore for init; that endpoint returns 401 in this preview cluster, so put_object_sync raises → routes/clinic_sync.py line 85 converts to HTTPException(502). Not caused by the translation sweep; renew the objstore credential or mock storage locally.
